name: @universe/universecore
description: The web engine for React Native macOS via Expo Modules: Chrome's own framework from our patched Chromium with our layer (engine/ardiacore), hosting Chrome tabs in the app's views.

scripts.test: node --test src/engine/api.test.mjs src/pageEvents.test.mjs tests/webkit-page-script.test.mjs tests/webkit-auto-pip.test.mjs tests/webkit-media-faults.test.mjs tests/webkit-warm.test.mjs && clang++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Werror tests/pip-zoom.test.cc -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-pip-zoom-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-pip-zoom-test" && clang++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Werror tests/pip-throw.test.cc -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-pip-throw-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-pip-throw-test" && clang++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Werror tests/window-sight.test.cc -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-window-sight-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-window-sight-test" && clang++ -std=c++20 -fobjc-arc -Wall -Werror -framework Foundation ios/ArdiaLaunchSequence.mm tests/launch-sequence.test.mm -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-launch-sequence-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-launch-sequence-test" && clang++ -std=c++20 -fobjc-arc -fsanitize=thread -g -Wall -Werror -framework Foundation ios/ArdiaTransferLedger.mm tests/transfer-ledger.test.mm -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-transfer-ledger-test" && TSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1 "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-transfer-ledger-test" && clang++ -std=c++20 -fobjc-arc -Wall -Werror -framework Foundation ios/ArdiaDownloadMover.mm tests/download-mover.test.mm -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-download-mover-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-download-mover-test" && clang++ -std=c++20 -fobjc-arc -Wall -Werror -framework Foundation tests/tab-lifecycle.test.mm -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-tab-lifecycle-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/universecore-tab-lifecycle-test"
